enum.orb.BLESSED_ORB.rule: Rerolls the values of the implicit modifiers
enum.orb.BOUNTY_ORB.rule: Maps only: an alchemy line — more loot
enum.orb.CHAOS_ORB.rule: Rerolls the affixes of a rare item
enum.orb.DIVINE_ORB.rule: Rerolls affix values, keeping the affixes and their tiers
enum.orb.ELDER_ORB.rule: Gives a rare item the Elder's influence and adds one of its modifiers
enum.orb.ELITE_ORB.rule: Maps only: an alchemy line — more rare monsters
enum.orb.EMPOWERING_ORB.rule: Maps only: every affix of the map rises a tier
enum.orb.EXALTED_ORB.rule: Adds one more affix to a rare item
enum.orb.FRACTURING_ORB.rule: Fractures a random affix of a rare item with at least four affixes
enum.orb.HORDE_ORB.rule: Maps only: an alchemy line — more monsters
enum.orb.MAGUS_ORB.rule: Maps only: an alchemy line — more magic monsters
enum.orb.MERCY_ORB.rule: Maps only: removes a random harmful affix and what it paid
enum.orb.MIRROR_OF_KALANDRA.rule: Creates an unalterable copy of the item
enum.orb.ORB_OF_ALCHEMY.rule: Upgrades a common item to rare and rolls its affixes
enum.orb.ORB_OF_ALTERATION.rule: Rerolls the affixes of a magic item
enum.orb.ORB_OF_AUGMENTATION.rule: Adds one more affix to a magic item
enum.orb.ORB_OF_CHANCE.rule: Turns a common item into a random rarity, rarely a unique
enum.orb.ORB_OF_REGRET.rule: Gives back a passive tree node: one orb per node
enum.orb.ORB_OF_SCOURING.rule: Strips every affix and returns the item to common
enum.orb.ORB_OF_TRANSMUTATION.rule: Upgrades a common item to magic and rolls its affixes
enum.orb.PERIL_ORB.rule: Maps only: adds a harmful affix beyond the limit
enum.orb.REGAL_ORB.rule: Upgrades a magic item to rare, keeping its affixes and adding one
enum.orb.SHAPERS_ORB.rule: Gives a rare item the Shaper's influence and adds one of its modifiers
enum.orb.VAAL_ORB.rule: Corrupts the item: adds a corruption modifier and locks it forever

expedition.note: A fight starts on «Begin» — and so does every next foe of a pack. Blows land at attack speed. Fire burns, cold chills and freezes, lightning shocks, chaos poisons, steel makes you bleed. Between fights life does not return on its own: in a fight regeneration and leech bring it back, on the map the fountains do. You can retreat from a fight. Loot, experience and the price of death are the server's. A cleared map can be played again.
